paragraphs: The 116d has been part of the 1 Series diesel range since the F20/F21 generation launched in 2011, running through to 2019. During that run, BMW used two different engines under the same badge. The earlier cars (2011 to 2015) have the N47 — a 1.6-litre four-cylinder diesel. In 2015, BMW switched to the B47 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel with significant revisions, including a re-engineered timing chain layout that addressed the N47's well-known weakness. The 116d was discontinued with the end of the F20/F21 generation in 2019, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The 116d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 1.6-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the 116d from 2011 to 2015. Known for timing chain failure due to chain guide wear — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every N47 rebuild.

A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the 116d from 2015 to 2019. The later, significantly revised unit with the timing chain moved to a more reliable position. We service it to the same standard as our other BMW diesel rebuilds.

compatibility.intro: Because BMW 116d can use the N47 or B47 engine code, fitting the wrong replacement risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N47 or B47) via registration or VIN

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic 116d quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
